target_customer: Upstream oil and gas operators and engineering teams (for example Senex in Queensland) that design wells and pipelines
problem: Well and pipeline design relies on manual engineering iteration; Endla's AlphaSpace generates many design options so engineers can pick the best return on investment.
product_category: Oil and gas engineering design automation software

founders.name: Riley O'Donnell
founders.background_notes: Source: YC page; process engineer who built internal software for his teams.

founders.name: Michael Moore
founders.background_notes: Source: YC page; software and infrastructure architecture consultant.

competitors.name: Tachyus
competitors.what: AI software for oil and gas production and well optimization
competitors.funding_then: Funded by Founders Fund per Fortune in June 2015

technical_complexity.rationale: Generating and ranking many feasible well and pipeline designs needs optimization and domain modeling, which is hard but within reach of two engineers with industry experience.

defensibility.rationale: Deep workflow integration with operator data and engineering domain knowledge are hard to copy quickly, but a long sales cycle and few customers limit it.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Large oilfield software vendors existed but no source shows them copying Endla; SLB bought Tachyus, a different company.

market_need_then: Operators wanted lower well costs and better returns in a post 2020 cost conscious industry; customer testimonials from Senex appear on Endla's site, but dated 2021 demand evidence was not found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Industrial, engineering focused tagline 'Industrial intelligence to grow asset value'

brand_strength.rationale: No press or community evidence about the brand itself was found.

pivots.to: Broader industrial intelligence platform with Deep Insight, pipelines, frac design and SmartRun
pivots.why: Visible only as product expansion on the current site; no dated source.

outcome_analysis: Endla is a small Brisbane company that went through YC in Summer 2021 and has expanded its product from well design to a wider platform with named customers. No institutional funding, exit or shutdown was found, so its trajectory beyond a niche enterprise software business is not visible in public sources.
notes: Aggregators (Extruct, Seedtable, Crunchbase) list a $125K YC and Uncommon Capital pre seed around August 2021; only aggregators, so unverified and not recorded as a round. Novi Labs (Austin) is a related oil and gas AI vendor but no dated source before the batch was found, so not listed. Tachyus relevance is judged from the category description only; its product details were not read. Name origin not found. Completeness pass: the $125K pre-seed rests on a single database (Extruct, echoed by Seedtable and Crunchbase); no press found.
